journey.name: Front Page Flow
journey.description: Tests the main home screen of the KoColor app.

actions.action: Verify that the 'Luxury Brand Logo' is visible at the top of the screen.
Check if 'Radiant Morning' or 'Deep Restoration' header is displayed based on current time.
Verify that 'The Vanity' section is visible if there are cosmetic items.
Tap the 'Settings' icon in the top right corner to open app settings.
Verify that the 'Settings' screen is displayed.
Tap the back button to return to the home screen.
